verses.text: That day you'll say, “Thank you, LORD. You were angry with me, but your anger has turned away and now you comfort me.
Look, God is the one who saves me. I'll trust him and won't be scared. The LORD, the LORD is my strength and my song. He's become my salvation.”
You'll draw water with joy from the wells of salvation.
That day you'll say, “Thank the LORD! Call on his name! Tell the peoples what he's done! Tell them how high his name is lifted!
Sing to the LORD! He's done amazing things. Let the whole earth hear about it!
People of Zion, raise your voices and shout! The Holy One of Israel is great right there among you!”
